title: Hand-drawn map of Little and Big Diomede islands with light observation point
description: Hand-drawn sketch map on an Air Intelligence Information Report (5004th Air Intel Sv Sq, IR 5004-40-53, Incl #1) showing the outlines of "LITTLE DIOMEDE" and "BIG DIOMEDE" with a north arrow. An arrow from "LITTLE DIOMEDE VILLAGE" (marked "25° ELEV.") runs "213° MAG. 2.5 MILES" to an asterisk labeled "POINT WHERE LIGHT WAS OBSERVED" and "APPROX. 95° ELEV." on Big Diomede. A vertical note at right reads "SEEN WITH THE NAKED EYE."
